findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Handwashing soap was not observed at the handwashing sink in the restroom. The person-in-charged (PIC) was informed by the inspector and handwashing soap was made available. Ensure handwashing soap is always available at the handwashing sink in the restroom.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Disposable towels were not observed in the handwashing sink at the restroom. The PIC was informed by the inspector and disposable paper towels were made available. Ensure disposable paper towels are available at the handwashing sink at all times.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [PF]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. The fan covers in the walk-in cooler was observed to have dust accumulation.
2. Spilled liquid soap from a Tide laundry detergent bottle was observed behind the shelf in the walk-in cooler. 
3. The shelf in the 3 door cooler for storing milk was observed to have soil accumulation.

The PIC was informed. Ensure the areas mentioned above are cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: The restroom handwashing sink was observed to have no hot water available. The PIC was informed. Ensure hot water is provided at the restroom handwashing sink at all times. The inspector will follow-up on March 16, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 5-103.11(B) Capacity. (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. [PF]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
THIRD REPEAT: The following areas were observed to be in need of repairs:

1. The space between the wall and the three-compartment sink was observed to be in need of caulking. Ensure the space is sealed to prevent water from entering and causing mold growth.
2. The ceiling tiles in the hallway behind the walk-in cooler and the hallway leading to the restroom were observed to be missing. Some of the tiles in both areas were also observed to be soggy. The PIC stated the landlord would be renovating the facility, including the ceiling tiles. Ensure the tiles are replaced for easy cleaning.
3. The space between the wall and the handwashing sink in the restroom was observed to be in need of caulking. Ensure the space is sealed to prevent water from entering and causing mold growth. 
4. Broken floor tiles and a sinking floor were observed in the backroom used for storing packs of water and paper towels. Ensure the floor tiles are replaced.
5. Bare wood was observed on the wall across the three-compartment sink. Ensure the bare wood is covered for easy cleaning. 

The followed areas were discussed with the PIC to have them repaired before the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Wet mop head was observed inside the three-compartment sink (used as a mop sink) facing downwards. The PIC was informed and educated on proper mop drying technique. Ensure wet mop heads are placed on a wringer basket or hanged up to allows them air-dry properly.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. [C]

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) 3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display.

Keep eggs stored on the low shelf - beneath juice and soda. CORRECTED- PIC rearranged so that eggs are stored on the lowest shelf.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools. 

Mop bucket observed containing used, dirty mop water. Discard mop water promptly after use. Stop storing mops in soiled mop water. Ensure that the mop head is hanging to facilitate drying.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) 6-304.11: If necessary to keep rooms free of excessive heat, steam, condensation, vapors, obnoxious odors, smoke, and fumes, mechanical ventilation of sufficient capacity shall be provided. 

Repair restroom ventilation so that it is operable.
